<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Civic Polls:</strong> The Karnataka government and State Election Commission have moved the Supreme Court to permit the holding of Bengaluru civic elections using existing electoral rolls.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Opposition Strategy:</strong> Rahul Gandhi has stated that the opposition is formulating a strategy to expose alleged electoral irregularities, asserting a commitment to democratic processes.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I10</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Political Appointments:</strong> The Congress party has officially approved a 42-member Pradesh Election Committee to oversee preparations for the upcoming Punjab Assembly elections.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirgFBVV95cUxOUFFqVThoVzU4dS1Mdi1QekRvT2E5NVZLUGZCdHBkcXNFUHY5N2hQZ3R2aERJbEd1b01CMVpXSWp2dUdRY0oxT1RVV1RBdE9jYnRacG9rMjJkcUt5Yzl6Nzg5WWtKWERvNEpsVUgyc1NUTnE5UFdGLTlTMFZPRm1Cdzc2TVNfN1V6QnktMm1HVTJLMFhaM1BFWG5WclNBaTd3bFFGYjVHcmpVQWJwbFE?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Mental Health Policy:</strong> Delhi has introduced a new mental health and well-being policy mandating the deployment of one counsellor for every 500 school students and 100 college students.</li>
</ul>
